Definition: a hundred; also as a multiplicative and a fraction
BiblicalUsage: A hundred is the number of fullness in counting: Adam lived a hundred and thirty years and begat a son, the children of Israel came out of Egypt six hundred thousand men on foot, and the census of the tribes is counted in hundreds.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the counting is God's way of saying He knows His people one by one: a hundred years of a life, six hundred thousand men on the march, and not one of them is lost in the number.
RelatedEvents: The Exodus and the Red Sea; Creation
